newsitem.title: USA: NYMEX crude retraces losses on late spread buying.
newsitem.headline: NYMEX crude retraces losses on late spread buying.

text.p: NYMEX crude retraced it losses shortly before the close Monday on intermonth spread buying after holding its session lows, traders said.
"Some big guys came in a tried to push it lower, but it held. They then decided to buy it, and there has been some good buying in the Feb/March," said a crude trader in New York.
At 1500 EST, February crude was unchanged at $25.08 a barrel, up from its session low of $24.68 hit earlier.
Refined products remained off, with heating oil still suffering the worst losses on warmer-than-expected temperature forecasts while supplies were deemed adequate.
January heating oil was off 2.07 cents at 70.90 cents a gallon, and January gasoline was off 1.44 cents at 68.75 cents a gallon.
-- Harry Milling, New York Energy Desk, 212-859-1761
